value.text: Add explicit user-facing safety messaging: document that generated outputs may expose private notes when hosted publicly; include a prominent pre-build warning in CLI help/docs; provide and document exclusion/ignore configuration patterns (e.g., ignore private folders/files) and generate a build report listing all included source files so users can review what will be published.

patch.value: Docs/CLI help contain a prominent warning about public hosting exposure; build output includes a human-readable manifest/report enumerating included files and configured excludes, enabling user review before deployment.

patch.value: Choose O1 (custom monolithic CLI pipeline) because it satisfies the static-output constraint and all MUST requirements with the least upfront framework/API design, enabling fast iteration and thin-slice delivery. The single-process in-memory graph is appropriate for an initial target consistent with R22 (up to ~1,000 notes) but actual scale remains to be confirmed via Q3; if Q3 indicates significantly larger datasets, revisit O4 or add chunking/incremental strategies.

value.text: Implement resilient front-matter parsing: treat malformed YAML front matter as a per-file warning by default (do not crash whole build), surface file path + error details in the build report, and allow a strict mode that fails the build when front matter is malformed.

patch.value: Given a fixture with one note containing malformed YAML front matter, the build completes and emits a clear warning identifying the file and parse error; tags/metadata for that note follow a documented fallback behavior.
